scenarios.criterion: The /reagent-map route and its nav link exist only when VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is exactly "true"; with it unset, empty, or any other value, there is no route and no link, and the app is otherwise unchanged. .env sets the flag to false.
scenarios.name: Reagent map route and nav link appear when the feature flag is explicitly true
given: VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is set to the literal string "true"
then: the /reagent-map route exists
the nav link to the reagent map is visible

scenarios.criterion: The /reagent-map route and its nav link exist only when VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is exactly "true"; with it unset, empty, or any other value, there is no route and no link, and the app is otherwise unchanged. .env sets the flag to false.
scenarios.name: Reagent map route and nav link are absent when the feature flag is off, unset, or any other value
given: VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is unset, empty, "false", or any value other than the literal string "true"
then: there is no /reagent-map route
there is no nav link to the reagent map
the rest of the application is unchanged

scenarios.criterion: The view runs Cesium with no network dependency: no ion token or ion imagery, baseLayerPicker and geocoder off, one equirectangular image of Aurelis served from the app's own files, Cesium's own static assets served same-origin via CESIUM_BASE_URL, scene mode SCENE3D, and an ellipsoid that is a sphere of radius 6,000 km.
scenarios.name: Reagent map globe renders entirely from the app's own files with no external network dependency
given: a visitor opens the reagent map view
then: the globe uses no Cesium Ion token and no Cesium Ion imagery
the base layer picker and geocoder controls are off
the globe surface shows one equirectangular image of Aurelis served from the app's own files
Cesium's own static assets load from the app's own origin
the globe is shown in 3D scene mode as a sphere with a 6,000 km radius

scenarios.criterion: The view sets window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ = { viewer, Cesium } and attaches saturdayMetadata { id, name, kind: 'site' } to every reagent site entity, per packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/README.md's seam contract.
scenarios.name: Reagent map exposes the Saturday test seam and tags each site with its metadata
given: a visitor opens the reagent map view
then: window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ exposes the viewer and the Cesium library
every reagent site entity carries saturdayMetadata with its id, name, and kind "site"

scenarios.criterion: Every one of the eight reagent sites is shown within 1 km of its published position and listed by name beside the globe, including Frostcap Hollow near the north pole and Tidewrack Shoals on the 180th meridian, each shown exactly once with no clipping or duplication.
scenarios.name: All eight reagent sites are shown exactly once at their published positions
given: a visitor opens the reagent map view
then: all eight reagent sites are shown, each within 1 km of its published position
each site appears exactly once, with no clipping or duplication
each site's name is listed beside the globe

scenarios.criterion: Every one of the eight reagent sites is shown within 1 km of its published position and listed by name beside the globe, including Frostcap Hollow near the north pole and Tidewrack Shoals on the 180th meridian, each shown exactly once with no clipping or duplication.
scenarios.name: Sites at the pole and the antimeridian are shown once, not duplicated
given: a visitor opens the reagent map view
Frostcap Hollow is published near the north pole at latitude 85, longitude 0
Tidewrack Shoals is published on the 180th meridian at latitude 0, longitude 180
then: Frostcap Hollow appears exactly once, within 1 km of its published position
Tidewrack Shoals appears exactly once, within 1 km of its published position, with no duplicate entity at the antimeridian wrap

scenarios.criterion: No request made while the reagent map view is open leaves the app's own origin or the mock API's own origin.
scenarios.name: No request leaves the app's own origin or the mock API's origin while the reagent map view is open
given: a visitor opens the reagent map view
when: the view is open and in use
then: every network request made stays on the app's own origin or the mock API's own origin
no request is made to any other origin

scenarios.criterion: A small pure function decides whether the /reagent-map route exists, tested for "true", "false", and unset without a browser. scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh starts the app with VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the pre-ship check exercises the view, while .env keeps the flag false. New specs named tests/reagent-map-*.spec.ts run only in the chrome Playwright project; npm run test:e2e (bundled Chromium) still passes without them.
scenarios.name: The feature flag decision is testable without a browser
given: a small pure function decides whether the /reagent-map route exists
when: that function is called with "true", "false", and an unset value
then: it returns true only for the literal string "true", and false for "false" and unset, without needing a browser

scenarios.criterion: A small pure function decides whether the /reagent-map route exists, tested for "true", "false", and unset without a browser. scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh starts the app with VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the pre-ship check exercises the view, while .env keeps the flag false. New specs named tests/reagent-map-*.spec.ts run only in the chrome Playwright project; npm run test:e2e (bundled Chromium) still passes without them.
scenarios.name: New reagent-map specs run only under the chrome Playwright project, leaving the default suite unaffected
given: new spec files named tests/reagent-map-*.spec.ts exist
apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/.env keeps the feature flag false
when: npm run test:e2e runs the bundled-Chromium suite
scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh starts the app with the feature flag set to true and runs the chrome project
then: npm run test:e2e still passes without running the new reagent-map specs
the chrome project run starts the app with the flag on and exercises the reagent map view
